# formal-counterex-zig (`SMC17/formal-counterex-zig`)

> Zig 0.16 CLI over a Lean 4 / Mathlib database of formally refuted and confirmed quantitative-finance claims.

## Key Links
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SMC17/formal-counterex-zig
- **Related (`zig-substrate`)**: https://github.com/SMC17/zinging
- **Author / Org**: https://github.com/SMC17

## Build & Run
- `zig build && zig build test`
- `./zig-out/bin/formal-counterex list-refuted`
- `./zig-out/bin/formal-counterex check es_is_coherent`
- [README](README.md) · [Build](build.zig) · [Source](src)
